producer: Program.Main creates one HostBuilder, adds Console logging, configures UseHttp2Cat with one RunTestCase delegate and awaits host.RunAsync.
The host/service extensions store that delegate/options, register the socket connection factory and one hosted service. StartAsync assigns RunAsync once.

The actual RunAsync connects once, constructs Http2Utilities with its logger/transport/token, awaits Options.Scenaro and stops the application in finally. There is no scenario retry or stress loop in this located producer.

The sample sends one stream1 request, receives headers, one intended DATA frame and trailers, logs decoded output and stops the connection. Header/trailer enumeration is not repetition of either retained site.
